items.evidence: Adjusted Net Revenue. For Messrs. Schultz, Maw and Johnson, # of their EMBP award was based on a consolidated adjusted net revenue goal.
Adjusted Operating Income. For Messrs. Schultz, Maw and Johnson, # of their total EMBP award was based on a consolidated adjusted operating income goal.
ROIC. For each of our NEOs, ROIC (measured on a consolidated basis) operated as a potential downward modifier of their combined adjusted net revenue and adjusted operating income result.
Performance RSUs. The extent to which performance RSUs vest is based on our achievement of #-year adjusted EPS and ROIC goals.
